student_learning_goal: I can be a Data Detective for a question I pick.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can be a Data Detective for a question I pick.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot and Tally together in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Question slot and choices.

image_placeholders.description: A question slot in B&W, ~7in x 1.5in. 'My question: ___'. 4 choice slots below. Header 'Part 1: My Question'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_QUESTION: keywords (question) name the slot.

image_placeholders.description: A tally chart in B&W, ~7in x 2in. 4 row categories. Tally areas. Header 'Part 2: Survey (6 classmates)'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_SURVEY: keywords (survey) name the chart.

parts.student_instructions: Make a pictograph from your tallies.

image_placeholders.description: A blank 4-row pictograph in B&W, ~7in x 2in. Header 'Part 3: Pictograph'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_GRAPH: keywords (pictograph) name the chart.

parts.student_instructions: Which has the most? Fewest? Are any equal?

image_placeholders.description: Three description slots in B&W, ~7in x 1.5in. 'Most: ___'. 'Fewest: ___'. 'Equal: ___'. Header 'Part 4: Describe'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P4_DESC: keywords (describe) name the slots.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and compare graphs.
